data.name: Vinodkumar
data.gender_notes: Vinodkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vinod means 'giver' and Kumar means 'young boy'. So, Vinodkumar means 'giver of joy' or 'giver of happiness'. The name Vinodkumar carries the meaning “Giver of Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vinodkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the joy and happiness that comes from giving and serving others.
data.etymology: Vinodkumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vinodkumar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vinodkumar is of Indian origin, specifically from Hindu culture. In Hinduism, naming a child is considered an important aspect of life, and a name often reflects the qualities and dreams that are wished for the child. The name Vinodkumar would generally be given to a young boy whose parents hope that he will grow up to be a giver of joy and happiness to those around him, just as the name suggests.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu thought, joy and happiness are considered important aspects of spiritual growth. The Bhagavad Gita, one of the foundational texts of Hinduism, teaches that one should strive for inner peace and joy, even amidst the challenges of life. Vinodkumar, as a name that denotes the inner quality of being a giver of joy, emphasizes this spiritual aspiration. By fulfilling this inner potential, one is not only bringing happiness to oneself and others, but also aligning oneself with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vinodkumar: Joyful Servant of God. In the name Vinodkumar, 'Vinod' signifies joy and 'Kumar' represents the embodiment of a young deity or servant. Hence, this name symbolizes a joyful servant of God.
